from harness import *
import json
defs = [["u", '"é"'],              # 2 bytes UTF-8
        ["b", "b'AB'"],
        ["c", "u + b"],            # 4 bytes: c3 a9 41 42
        ["d", "c[1:3]"],           # bytes a9 41
        ["e", "c[:]"],
        ["f", "b[0:1] * 3"],
        ["g", "3 * f"],
        ["h", "d + e[:0]"],
        ["i", "(c)"],
        ["empty", "b''"],
        ["zr", "b'x' * 0"]]
d = doc(definitions=defs, timeout_ms=5,
        channels=[ch('ch', (None, '{{ u }}'), (None, '{{ d }}'), (None, '{{ f }}'), (None,'{{ g }}'),
                     (None,'{{ h }}'), (None,'{{ empty }}'), (None,'{{ zr }}'), (None,'{{ i }}'), (None,'{{ e }}'))])
o,rc,err = run(d, debug=True)
if 'error' in o: print(err[-1500:]); raise SystemExit
def naive(b):
    x=0
    for y in b: x=(x*257+y+1)&((1<<64)-1)
    return {'n':len(b),'h':'%016x'%x}
expect = [ 'é'.encode(), 'é'.encode()[1:3]+b'', b'AAA', b'AAA', 'é'.encode()[1:3], b'', b'', 'é'.encode()+b'AB', 'é'.encode()+b'AB']
got = o['channels'][0]['bytes']
# whole channel = concatenation
whole = b''.join(expect)
print('channel', got, naive(whole), got==naive(whole))
# verify individual pieces via separate single-part channels
for i,(src, exp) in enumerate(zip(['u','d','f','g','h','empty','zr','i','e'], expect)):
    dd = doc(definitions=defs, timeout_ms=5, channels=[ch('c',(None,'{{ %s }}'%src))])
    oo = run(dd)[0]
    ok = oo['channels'][0]['bytes']==naive(exp)
    print(src, ok, oo['channels'][0]['bytes'], naive(exp))
EOF
